title: Check-In Call Miss Rate
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:checkin contact_name=* call_answered=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(call_answered="no",1,0))) as matched by contact_name
| eval a_missed_check_in_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_missed_check_in_pct
description: Measures the percentage of care check-in calls that end with a missed check-in by contact.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which contact are helping or hurting care check-in calls.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a missed check-in` on `care:checkin` events and summarize the hit rate by `contact_name`.
visualization: Table of contact with percentage of care check-in calls ending with a missed check-in.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often a missed check-in happens for each contact so you can see where care check-in calls go smoothly or get stuck.
